current.statement: Formal roadmap governance is Approved. Current mainline is realized-profit closure, then economic-assumption consolidation, then strategy/capital optimization.
Current final automatic alert floor is verified net profit >= 50,000,000 ISK. Lower scanner discovery thresholds remain allowed.
Non-BPC executable opportunities require >= 2,000 ISK/m3 profit density.
>5B pure multi-item contracts use an independent engine; only 5-8B ACTIONABLE contracts that are SAFE, >=500M conservative net profit, >=10% ROI and positive under stress may alert.
MikeChong and LadyBaBa primarily procure; inventory is transferred internally and LadyGuaGua primarily sells. Internal transfers do not reset cost basis.

BPC manufacturing automatic alerts use an independent stricter gate without changing 4-H: V2 SAFE, remote-route live net profit >=100M ISK, live ROI >=15%, stress profit >=50M; Jita-manufacture cost must be complete, conservative Jita live net profit >=50M, Jita ROI >=10%, and Jita stress profit >0. User-facing BPC mail displays the Jita-manufacture economics.
